source: hand-entered from the public AWS price pages; the refresh script against the Price List Bulk API lands with the pricing ticket

freeTier.label: assumes classic free tier
freeTier.note: New AWS accounts moved to a credit-based free tier in July 2025. These are the classic allowances (always-free for Lambda, 12 months for the rest), account-wide, with the RDS hours and storage tied to one single-AZ instance of an eligible class; the pricing ticket must verify them before this label changes.
